rule: Operations > 10s expose a cancel affordance; cancellation restores prior state where possible.
placement: Co-located with the progress indicator, within the same component region.
label: action-label slot — verb-first imperative ('Cancel', 'Stop').

stateRestoration.canceledBeforeCommit: Discard partial work; restore prior state as if not invoked.
stateRestoration.canceledAfterCommit: If side effects already began, run compensating action (see recall window in safety skill).
stateRestoration.canceledMidStream: Preserve streamed content; mark as 'canceled'; do not blank.

keyboard.shortcut: Escape when focused within the progress region

refusal: Non-cancelable operations over 10s — users are trapped.
Cancel that leaves partial state without cleanup.
Cancel that requires navigation away from the current surface.
